Policies

Terms & Conditions

Text Messaging Terms

By signing up for text message updates, you agree to receive survey, polling, or voting-related (non-partisan) text messages from Equality Ohio Education Fund at the mobile number you provided. Message frequency may vary based on your interactions, upcoming events, or important notices from Equality Ohio Education Fund. Message and data rates may apply depending on your mobile carrier plan. For assistance, reply HELP or email us at info@equalityohio.org, call us at 614-224-0400, or send mail to 370 S 5th St Ste G3 Columbus OH 43215. You can reply STOP to opt out of text messages at any time. Text messaging opt-in data and consent will not be sold or shared with third parties or affiliates for their marketing or promotional purposes. For more information about how we collect, use, or share your data, please review our Privacy Policy here.
